Private Function Hexed(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, out As String
    If VarType(value) <> vbString Then
        Hexed = TypeName(value) & " " & CStr(value)
        Exit Function
    End If
    For i = 1 To Len(value)
        out = out & " " & Hex$(AscW(Mid$(value, i, 1)) And &HFFFF&)
    Next
    Hexed = "String" & out & " /" & LenB(value)
End Function

Private Function Passed(ByVal value As String) As String
    Passed = value
End Function

Private Function Case0() As String
    Dim s As String, r As Variant, v As Variant, w As Variant, e As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    v = StrConv("abc", vbFromUnicode)
    w = StrConv("abcd", vbFromUnicode)
    e = StrConv("", vbFromUnicode)
    Err.Clear: r = TypeName(v): If Err.Number Then s = s & "|E" & Err.Number Else s = s & "|" & Hexed(r)
    Case0 = s
End Function
